metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for designers. Figma, design review, and more.

plugins.name: designagent
plugins.description: Claude Code's live two-way bridge to Figma — read, build, and edit the canvas in real time, then build production UI from a design-system-faithful DESIGN.md.

plugins.name: setup
plugins.description: Set up a project for design work in Claude Code — scaffold DESIGN.md (tokens), CLAUDE.md (design intelligence), and DECISIONS.md, tailored to your stack. The fastest on-ramp for designers new to Claude Code.

plugins.name: superdesigner
plugins.description: AI design review — connects PRD, research, Figma, and analytics to surface gaps and blind spots before handoff.

plugins.name: tokens
plugins.description: Extract your design tokens from code — colors, spacing, type, radius — with deterministic clustering and hardcoded-value drift detection, and keep DESIGN.md in sync.

plugins.name: design-qa
plugins.description: Does the build match the design? Screenshots your running UI, diffs it against the Figma frame / DESIGN.md, and reports layout, spacing, color, and type drift by severity.

plugins.name: backgrounds
plugins.description: Generate self-contained, brand-aware background effects — animated WebGL shader, dot-grid, or ASCII art — recolored from your DESIGN.md, with reduced-motion and fallbacks baked in.
